facts.claim: Bureau of Meteorology, Solstices, equinoxes and the seasons (updated 17 September 2026, read 20 November 2026): 'Australian summer, autumn, winter and spring are defined as: summer – the warmest 3 months: December, January and February; winter – the coolest 3 months: June, July and August; spring and autumn – the 3-month transition periods between summer and winter.'
Bureau of Meteorology, same page: 'for Australia it's a better fit with our temperatures to use 1 March, 1 June, 1 September and 1 December' to start each season.

Bureau of Meteorology, same page: 'For Australia's northern tropics ... the European 4-season model isn't relevant.' The year is divided into a 'wet season' (October to April) and a 'dry season' (May to September).
